label: Technique Murray 5: the waves 30 degrees off the course

test.title: Murray 5: the waves 30 degrees off the course
test.purpose: The 3 ft sea running 30 degrees off the course: most of the time diagonal toward the course, with turns to square or past it now and then. Murray Stewart's cues (Rottnest camp, November 2026): catch a wave, as square as needed; stay high on its face (ease off, let the push hold you); scan 3 to 8 m ahead of the bow, within 30 degrees either side, for darker patches on the back faces ahead; when one is in reach, sprint to drop and move to it, to be on the upper part of the next wave's face there; prefer running diagonal to square.
lookFor: how much of the time you run diagonal toward the course, and when you turn square
your speed through the water on a diagonal against square
